title: Boeing spent $43B on its own shares. Then the bill came
sentence: From 2013 to 2019, Boeing spent $43.4 billion on share buybacks and $15.7 billion on commercial airplane R&D (Fortune analysis); from 2019 to 2024 it lost about $35.7 billion (our sum of Boeing's annual results).
source: Fortune, The 737 Max crisis and Boeing's shareholder-first culture: https://fortune.com/longform/boeing-737-max-crisis-shareholder-first-culture
